title: customer.export_ready v1
description: A GDPR export bundle is built and downloadable by the customer (Store API getMyExport, signed in) and by store admins (Admin API getCustomerExport) until expires_at. Ids and timestamps only — never the bundle, never personal data. Consumers: the notifications app tells the customer by email (it reads the address from the customer row at send time; the mail carries no token and no link with credentials).
